about: Frozen mocap selection for protagonist_human's locomotion. Crops re-derivable and checkable with freeze_mocap.py; zips, hashes and licence verdicts in C:/forge-assets/thirdparty/MANIFEST.md (license research: docs/research/mocap-and-base-mesh.md). Rows are 0-based MOTION rows, inclusive.

credits.cmu: The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217. (courtesy acknowledgment requested; BVH conversion by B. Hahne, cgspeed 2010 release)
credits.100style: Locomotion styles derived from the 100STYLE dataset (Mason et al.), CC BY 4.0. (OBLIGATION: this line in the shipped game's credits)

clips.why: CMU subject 08 'walk': straight (1.00), steady, the brisker of the clean walks (1.533 m/s at rig scale vs 39_01 1.392) toward the game's 2.0 m/s walk

source.rows_note: row 0 is the converter's added T-pose, dropped; 120 fps
